project_metadata.job_description:
PPC Audit for brand new account. 

For Stephen Fitz only

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Add me to Google Ads
Go to <http://ads.google.com|ads.google.com>
Click on Admin Gear Icon bottom left
Click Access and Security
Click the blue button and add contact@payperclix.com as read-only
If it makes you complete a 2FA task, you may need to send the invite a second time for it to go through.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For context, I haven't launched any campaigns. Just tried to throw one together and realized I better consult an expert.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I see. Typically, an audit is for past / current performance. I can look over your account and website and propose a plan - what I would do to scale your results.
Does that sound good?
I'll also do an audit on what you've drafted.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: More context: I am specifically targeted folks looking for estate planning services (as opposed to other estate law services like estate administration, probate, elder law, etc). Got kind of confused when I saw this forecast suggest that I'd see a sharp drop off in ROAS when spending $2,000 or more. Felt weird that I could only squeeze out 20 monthly form fills (and maybe 3 conversions) when targeting a pretty large geographic area (all of New Jersey, and the affluent Philly suburb counties). But maybe that's the limit? Maybe the forecast tool isn't accurate pre-campaign launch? Once, you'd have a chance to look let me know what is even possible to know at this point.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hey Stephen - just realized we didn’t establish a deadline. No rush. Is Friday okay?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hi Tommy, audit and buildout proposal is complete.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Thank you and please let me know if you have any follow up questions.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hey Stephen - looks good. One question before we start. Definitely fine with starting at $2k per month to test the water. But do you see room for scaling? I know we will have a better idea once we have some data from the few months. But just curious about what you can see now.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Other than that, question, I am ready to launch the 7 hour buildout.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I will go in and fix that layout issue that comes up on wide screens.
